yuhuating_divestment.v: Divestment of CapitaMall Yuhuating completed on 31 October 2025. Sale price: RMB 813.8 million. Sold 100% equity interest in the SPV holding CapitaMall Yuhuating to Changsha 2023 Consulting & Management Co., Ltd. through Changsha Kaiting Consulting & Management Co., Ltd. (each an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of CapitaLand Mall Asia Limited). This was a sale to CapitaLand Commercial C-REIT (CLCR), listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange on 29 September 2025. Sold at ~4% above 2024 book value; exit NPI yield of 6.2% based on FY2024 NPI of RMB50.7m. Independent valuations: Colliers at RMB 748.0m, CBRE at RMB 780.0m. Loss on disposal (S$11,988k) mainly due to realisation of foreign exchange differences upon divestment, partially offset by premium over 2024 valuation.
